confidence_notes: Meals, coffee and beer are anchored to current Kandy cost-of-living aggregates; those figures have limited local contributions. Cocktail pricing is less certain and follows the local beer-to-cocktail price relationship. Wine by the glass is estimated from the local mid-range bottle price and its relationship to beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on the supplied peer-city prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kandy's inland cultural-tourism demand suggests three-star room prices near Trincomalee and Unawatuna, above Dambulla's lower baseline and below Colombo. Basic rooms and hostels are estimated near Dambulla and Trincomalee.
